experiment_data.hypothesis: G-MFRM joint estimation 的 Arena correlation (τ) 随 judge 数量单调递增且存在 diminishing returns：3 judges 即可超越 baseline (τ>0.786)，6+ judges 接近饱和。不同 judge subset 组合的方差随 judge 数增加而收缩。

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python run_exp006.py --methods raw_average joint_gmfrm sequential --judge-counts 2 4 6 9 --run-loocv --output-dir results_full
spec.model_name: G-MFRM judge count sensitivity (raw_average + sequential + joint_gmfrm)
